items.title: Russia finalizes crypto trading rules ahead of Nov. 17 rollout
items.summary: The rules allow retail investors to trade BTC, ETH and USDT through regulated intermediaries, with Moscow Exchange planning to launch crypto trading in December.

items.title: Strive buys 15,124 Bitcoin in October, closes in on top treasury holders
items.summary: Bitcoin treasury company Strive reported $509 million in third-quarter net income and purchased 15,124 BTC in October, bringing its total holdings to 43,124 BTC.

items.title: Bitcoin price dips under $75K as crypto markets miss tech-stock rebound
items.summary: BTC price action stayed weak after US nonfarm payrolls data significantly beat forecasts, increasing bets of a December interest-rate hike.

items.title: What Democrats US midterm sweep means for the CLARITY Act
items.summary: The CLARITY Act faces a new test as Democrats control Congress, raising questions over consumer protections, ethics and what the crypto industry may have to concede.

items.title: Nigeria sets new crypto licensing rules, bans algorithmic stablecoins
items.summary: Nigeria has banned algorithmic stablecoins and introduced reserve requirements for issuers as it expands central bank oversight of crypto payment services.

items.title: Heres what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Bleed $430 Million as Tech Rout Tests Wall Street Buyers
items.summary: Fidelity and BlackRock led Thursday's Bitcoin ETF withdrawals as a technology-stock selloff rattled risk assets.

items.title: US Sanctions 45 More Targets Tied to Alleged Crypto Scam Empire Prince Group
items.summary: OFAC targeted offshore companies and associates it says helped Prince Group executives hide assets and dodge earlier sanctions.

items.title: Crypto Card Provider Gnosis Pay Says Hackers Accessed Customer Data
items.summary: Gnosis Pay said hackers accessed customer information on the legacy system behind its branded cards, though funds werent affected and its enterprise card platform was untouched.

items.title: Crypto Liquidations Top $1 Billion as Bitcoin Tests 11-Week Low
items.summary: Bitcoin fell toward $75,500 after AI stocks plunged, and over $1 billion in the crypto derivatives market has been wiped out.

items.title: Anthropic IPO Valuation Could Be Slashed in Half to $1T After AI Stock Rout: Report
items.summary: Investors told The Wall Street Journal that the $1.5 trillion target now looks too high, as prediction markets bet on a December listing.

items.title: $3.1B in Stolen Binance Crypto Has Yet to Be Laundered: Elliptic
items.summary: The attackers have used more than 20,000 wallets on 16 blockchains so far, but the bulk of the stolen ETH and Bitcoin hasn't moved.

items.title: Gnosis Pay data breach exposes customer info; funds unaffected
items.summary: Gnosis Pay disclosed a data breach after unauthorized access to its legacy debit card system on Nov. 3. Customer funds were not affected.

items.title: Trump administration moves closer to allowing crypto in 401(k) retirement plans
items.summary: A rule that would open up 401(k) retirement accounts to alternative assets, including cryptocurrencies, has landed at the White House.

items.title: Elliptic says Binance hackers swapped stolen tokens for $124M in bitcoin, exchange plans more withdrawal reopenings
items.summary: Elliptic says little of the stolen crypto has likely been cashed out, while $2.85 billion remains frozen.

items.title: Strives bitcoin gains drive $509 million Q3 profit as BTC buying ramps up
items.summary: Strives bitcoin stash reached 43,124 BTC as its shares continued to slide despite a profitable third quarter.

items.title: Aave Labs buys Avon team in fixed-rate lending push
items.summary: Aave Labs acquired the team and technology of Avon, an onchain fixed-rate and floating-rate lending protocol.

items.title: TeraWulfs bitcoin mining revenue falls 69% as HPC leasing surges amid Anthropic buildout
items.summary: TeraWulf reported $63 million in artificial intelligence-related quarterly HPC lease revenue, up 774% year over year.
